title: Copying the remaining input
statement: Let $x$ and $rest$ be Boolean strings, let $i$ be a natural number, and let $c$ be a zero-work-tape configuration on input $x$. Suppose that deleting the first $i$ bits of $x$ gives $rest$, that $i\leq |x|$, that $c$ is in the copy state, and that its input head is at position $i+1$. After $|rest|+1$ steps, the machine is halted and its output is the original output of $c$ followed by $rest$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a zero-work-tape configuration on input $x$
$x$ with its first $i$ bits removed equals $rest$
